PROFILE

Tora Drums is a Vietnamese drummer and songwriter. Her high-energy rock drum covers first brought her wide recognition, gathering tens of millions of views across digital platforms. She is also an original artist, with three solo drum compositions that show her musical identity and technical depth.

She reached a younger audience with the viral song “Bat Anh Ve”, a step beyond instrumental playing into songwriting.

Tora came to the drums almost by chance, but curiosity soon became destiny. An expressive, powerful style, a gentle appearance, a strong rock aesthetic and advanced technique together form her signature.

She graduated from the Military University of Culture and Arts, majoring in Western musical instruments (drum set), and won multiple awards during her professional training. With her band she has played major stages and international festivals, including Monsoon Music Festival Vietnam and Baybeats Festival Singapore.

Driven by a deep passion for music and relentless rhythm, Tora keeps pushing creative boundaries and is preparing the next bold chapter of her career, aiming to inspire audiences worldwide.
